description: Merged trade feed across every wallet on your Robinhood Chain watchlist, newest first, each row labelled with its watchlist label. The cursor (next_before) is an opaque keyset matching the rest of the RHC tree, NOT the Solana tracker's integer epoch. A `wallet` filter must already be on your watchlist or the call returns 400. Tier: PRO+.

before.description: Opaque keyset cursor — pass the previous response's next_before

token.description: Restrict to one token address (0x, 40 hex)

wallet.description: Restrict to one tracked wallet (must already be on the watchlist)

name: rhc_wallet_tracker_trades
